subject.title: fix(ui): nudge stale tabs after gateway updates

question: After a redacted real browser-and-gateway upgrade trace is supplied, should this protected PR land with the explicit user-triggered refresh behavior for stale Control UI tabs?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires human handling, and tests cannot establish the real reconnect lifecycle across a running gateway update.

options.title: Require live reconnect proof
options.body: Request a redacted recording, terminal/live output, or diagnostic trace showing the gateway upgrade, reconnect banner, and refresh result before deciding to merge.

options.title: Accept static validation only
options.body: Merge based on focused tests and CI while accepting that the browser-and-gateway upgrade path was not directly observed.

recommendation.title: Require live reconnect proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted recording, terminal/live output, or diagnostic trace showing the gateway upgrade, reconnect banner, and refresh result before deciding to merge.
